description: Read the frontier price model: one network trained on millions of simulated markets across every vertical, pricing topology, unit, buyer and channel, run inside Last Price on every request with no GPU. Shows which version runs (a stored one, or the seed that ships with Last Price), how much profit it gives up on the eval's one-look markets (lower is better) and the stored versions. Answers released: false while it is not switched on for your workspace. Read only. Needs a Last Price credential with routing read scope.
name: get_frontier_model
